title: [Bug] Unable to engage in more than two rounds of conversation with Deepseeker R1
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.49.5

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

When there are more than one message, using deepseek-r1 will report the following error:

{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request_error",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "message": "The first message (except the system message) of deepseek-reasoner must be a user message, but an assistant message detected."
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
  "provider": "deepseek"
}

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Sending more than two messages

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

Reply normally

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves a problem with the LLM provider Deepseeker R1, specifically related to message handling and integration with the agent system, which aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category.
